name: Fundamentally Cynical
overview: Fundamentally Cynical is a fast-paced, animated sci-fi series created by Preston Hazard, centered on the overly cheerful (and dim-witted) counselor Lizard Boy and a group of cynical campers at "Camp Dingle-dork". The show, which debuted in 2019, features a cast including Preston Hazard, Tad Doyle, and Dave Abbruzzese, and explores sci-fi and fantasy themes through its comedic premise.
